blocking_condition.summary: Both p3 cells MUST refuse to run: the verify_code_change proposal seam cannot emit a machine-valid proposal for them (contract on_missing: halt), and the p1 contract requires cells to refuse rather than hand-author a proposal.
technical_root_cause: The proposal seam requires ast_parse_coverage AND code_change_risk as on_missing:halt facts. Verified concretely: build_verify_proposal raises ValueError ('required fact ast_parse_coverage not measured') on the delta-only facts a data-only cell produces.

code_change_risk is only minted when >=1 term is measurable (sonar criticals / lsp errors / tests-ratio / impacted). run_workflow.py's _run_change_analysis injects NO sonar/lsp into ChangeInput, so those terms are always absent; tests-ratio needs changed_symbol_count>0; impacted needs the graph.
The graph leg degrades to unavailable (30s client-side deadline) at full-repo scale, so impacted is never measured for these cells.

per_cell.labbook_refresh: Phases regenerate data artifacts (lab_*.json, data.js, parquet, manifest) — no Python source change, so changed_symbol_count=0 AND ast_parse_coverage is omitted (no changed Python files). Work is also already merged (lab outputs are present and freshly regenerated by p2's test phase).
per_cell.queue_steer: The reinterleave script + admin endpoint + tests already exist (scripts/reinterleave_queue.py, POST /api/queue/reinterleave, tests/test_reinterleave_queue.py), so there is no code change to propose on. Its 'interrupt' phase SIGKILLs worker.py and 'respawn' respawns workers — destructive live side effects that are inappropriate for a shadow (never-applied) cell.

outcome_protocol_note: Because the cells did not run, there are no realized outcomes to adjudicate: no realized_depth, no realized_symbol_set, no hit/miss. outcome=not-run for both cells, never inferred.
